claims.title: Oleg seizes Kiev and founds Kievan Rus'
claims.summary: The Varangian prince Oleg, successor to Rurik of Novgorod, captures Kiev and makes it his capital, uniting the river towns of the Dnieper-Volkhov route into the first East Slavic state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-882-oleg-seizes-kiev-and-founds-kievan-rus, claim TL:RUS:event:882:oleg-seizes-kiev-and-founds-kievan-rus, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Vladimir the Great adopts Orthodox Christianity
claims.summary: Vladimir of Kiev is baptized and orders the mass baptism of his people in the Dnieper, adopting Byzantine Orthodox Christianity as the state religion and binding the Rus' to Constantinople's faith and culture.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-988-vladimir-the-great-adopts-orthodox-christianity, claim TL:RUS:event:988:vladimir-the-great-adopts-orthodox-christianity, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Yaroslav the Wise and the Russkaya Pravda
claims.summary: Under Yaroslav the Wise, Kievan Rus' reaches a cultural peak; he issues the Russkaya Pravda, the earliest East Slavic written law code, and patronizes churches and learning in Kiev.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1019-yaroslav-the-wise-and-the-russkaya-pravda, claim TL:RUS:event:1019:yaroslav-the-wise-and-the-russkaya-pravda, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Mongol invasion and the fall of Kiev
claims.summary: Batu Khan's Mongol army sacks the Rus' principalities, destroying Ryazan and Vladimir and storming Kiev in December 1240; the Russian lands become tributaries of the Golden Horde.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1237-mongol-invasion-and-the-fall-of-kiev, claim TL:RUS:event:1237:mongol-invasion-and-the-fall-of-kiev, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Great Stand on the Ugra ends the Mongol yoke
claims.summary: Ivan III, having stopped paying tribute, faces down the Great Horde at the Ugra River; the bloodless standoff is traditionally regarded as the end of Mongol overlordship and the rise of a sovereign Muscovite state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1480-the-great-stand-on-the-ugra-ends-the-mongol-yoke, claim TL:RUS:event:1480:the-great-stand-on-the-ugra-ends-the-mongol-yoke, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ivan IV crowned first Tsar of All Russia
claims.summary: Ivan IV is crowned 'Tsar of All Russia' in the Cathedral of the Dormition in the Moscow Kremlin, becoming the first Russian ruler to hold the imperial title and converting the Grand Principality of Moscow into the Tsardom of Russia.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1547-ivan-iv-crowned-first-tsar-of-all-russia, claim TL:RUS:event:1547:ivan-iv-crowned-first-tsar-of-all-russia, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Conquest of the Khanate of Kazan
claims.summary: Ivan IV captures Kazan, and in 1556 Astrakhan, destroying the successor states of the Golden Horde on the Volga and opening the river and the route to Siberia to Russian colonization.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1552-conquest-of-the-khanate-of-kazan, claim TL:RUS:event:1552:conquest-of-the-khanate-of-kazan, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Time of Troubles
claims.summary: After the Rurikid line dies out, Russia descends into the Time of Troubles, a period of famine, civil war, pretenders, and Polish occupation of Moscow that nearly destroys the Russian state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1598-the-time-of-troubles, claim TL:RUS:event:1598:the-time-of-troubles, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Michael Romanov elected tsar
claims.summary: A national assembly (Zemsky Sobor) elects sixteen-year-old Michael Romanov as tsar, ending the Time of Troubles and founding the Romanov dynasty that will rule Russia for three centuries.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1613-michael-romanov-elected-tsar, claim TL:RUS:event:1613:michael-romanov-elected-tsar, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Russian explorers reach the Pacific
claims.summary: Cossacks and fur traders crossing Siberia reach the Pacific coast, extending the Russian state across northern Asia and giving it a vast Eurasian dominion within a single century of expansion.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1639-russian-explorers-reach-the-pacific, claim TL:RUS:event:1639:russian-explorers-reach-the-pacific, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Peter the Great proclaims the Russian Empire
claims.summary: After victory over Sweden in the Great Northern War and the Treaty of Nystad, the Senate proclaims Peter I 'Emperor of All Russia,' transforming the Tsardom into the Russian Empire and confirming Russia as a European great power.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1721-peter-the-great-proclaims-the-russian-empire, claim TL:RUS:event:1721:peter-the-great-proclaims-the-russian-empire, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The reign of Catherine the Great
claims.summary: Catherine II expands the empire to the Black Sea and through the three Partitions of Poland, patronizes the arts and Enlightenment ideas, and founds the Hermitage collection, while serfdom reaches its most oppressive extent.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1762-the-reign-of-catherine-the-great, claim TL:RUS:event:1762:the-reign-of-catherine-the-great, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Napoleon's invasion and retreat from Moscow
claims.summary: Napoleon's Grande Armee invades Russia and reaches a burning Moscow, but is destroyed by attrition, scorched earth, and the Russian winter; the catastrophe makes Russia a leading power of post-Napoleonic Europe.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1812-napoleon-s-invasion-and-retreat-from-moscow, claim TL:RUS:event:1812:napoleon-s-invasion-and-retreat-from-moscow, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Emancipation of the serfs
claims.summary: Tsar Alexander II issues the Emancipation Manifesto, freeing more than twenty million serfs of the Russian Empire; the landmark reform grants legal freedom but leaves peasants burdened by redemption payments and land hunger.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1861-emancipation-of-the-serfs, claim TL:RUS:event:1861:emancipation-of-the-serfs, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Revolution of 1905
claims.summary: Defeat by Japan and the 'Bloody Sunday' shooting of demonstrators spark strikes, mutinies, and unrest across the empire, forcing Nicholas II to grant a parliament (Duma) and limited civil liberties in the October Manifesto.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1905-the-revolution-of-1905, claim TL:RUS:event:1905:the-revolution-of-1905, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: February Revolution and the abdication of Nicholas II
claims.summary: Bread riots, strikes, and a garrison mutiny in Petrograd force Nicholas II to abdicate, ending the Romanov dynasty and over three centuries of tsarist rule; a Provisional Government takes power alongside the Petrograd Soviet.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1917-february-revolution-and-the-abdication-of, claim TL:RUS:event:1917:february-revolution-and-the-abdication-of, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The October Revolution
claims.summary: Lenin's Bolsheviks overthrow the Provisional Government in a near-bloodless coup in Petrograd, proclaim a government of soviets, and establish the world's first communist state, withdrawing Russia from the First World War.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1917-the-october-revolution, claim TL:RUS:event:1917:the-october-revolution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Execution of the Romanov family
claims.summary: Bolshevik guards shoot and bayonet the deposed Nicholas II, his wife, their five children, and their servants in a cellar in Yekaterinburg, eliminating any rallying point for the monarchist cause.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1918-execution-of-the-romanov-family, claim TL:RUS:event:1918:execution-of-the-romanov-family, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Russian Civil War
claims.summary: Trotsky's Red Army battles the anti-communist Whites, foreign interventionists, and nationalist forces in a devastating civil war marked by the Red Terror and mass famine, leaving millions dead before the Bolsheviks prevail.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1918-the-russian-civil-war, claim TL:RUS:event:1918:the-russian-civil-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Founding of the Soviet Union
claims.summary: The Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, and Transcaucasian Soviet republics formally unite to create the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, a federal one-party communist state with its capital at Moscow.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1922-founding-of-the-soviet-union, claim TL:RUS:event:1922:founding-of-the-soviet-union, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Holodomor and the Soviet famine
claims.summary: Forced collectivization and ruthless grain requisitioning produce a man-made famine across the USSR; in Ukraine the Holodomor kills an estimated 3.5 to 5 million people and is recognized by many countries as a genocide.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1932-the-holodomor-and-the-soviet-famine, claim TL:RUS:event:1932:the-holodomor-and-the-soviet-famine, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Great Terror
claims.summary: Stalin's secret police carry out mass arrests, deportations, and executions; at least 750,000 people are shot in two years and millions more sent to the gulag, as old revolutionaries, officers, and ordinary citizens perish in the purges.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1937-the-great-terror, claim TL:RUS:event:1937:the-great-terror, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Great Patriotic War
claims.summary: Nazi Germany's invasion of 22 June 1941 begins the war's deadliest theater; after the siege of Leningrad and the decisive victory at Stalingrad, Soviet forces reach Berlin in 1945 at a cost of roughly 27 million Soviet dead.

sources.label: The Eastern Front: The German War against the Soviet Union
World War II casualties of the Soviet Union

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1941-the-great-patriotic-war, claim TL:RUS:event:1941:the-great-patriotic-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human in space
claims.summary: Cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin orbits the Earth aboard Vostok 1, a triumph of the Soviet space program that followed the launch of Sputnik in 1957 and symbolized Soviet scientific power in the Cold War.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1961-yuri-gagarin-becomes-the-first-human-in-space, claim TL:RUS:event:1961:yuri-gagarin-becomes-the-first-human-in-space, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Dissolution of the Soviet Union
claims.summary: Weakened by economic stagnation, nationalist movements, and a failed August coup, the USSR is dissolved; Mikhail Gorbachev resigns on 25 December 1991 and the Soviet flag is lowered over the Kremlin for the last time.

sources.label: The collapse of the Soviet Union

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1991-dissolution-of-the-soviet-union, claim TL:RUS:event:1991:dissolution-of-the-soviet-union, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Birth of the Russian Federation
claims.summary: As the USSR dissolves, the Russian Federation becomes its principal successor state, inheriting the Soviet UN Security Council seat and nuclear arsenal, with Boris Yeltsin as its first president.

sources.label: The collapse of the Soviet Union

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1991-birth-of-the-russian-federation, claim TL:RUS:event:1991:birth-of-the-russian-federation, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Constitutional crisis and new constitution
claims.summary: A standoff between President Yeltsin and parliament ends with the army shelling the legislature; a referendum in December 1993 adopts a new constitution that concentrates power in a strong presidency.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-1993-constitutional-crisis-and-new-constitution, claim TL:RUS:event:1993:constitutional-crisis-and-new-constitution, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Vladimir Putin becomes president
claims.summary: After Yeltsin's resignation, Vladimir Putin wins the presidency and, aided by rising oil and gas revenues, stabilizes the economy while progressively centralizing political power and curbing independent media.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-2000-vladimir-putin-becomes-president, claim TL:RUS:event:2000:vladimir-putin-becomes-president, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Annexation of Crimea
claims.summary: Following the fall of Ukraine's pro-Russian president, Russian forces seize Crimea and Moscow annexes the peninsula, an action recognized by almost no other state, while Russia backs separatists in eastern Ukraine.

sources.label: Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-2014-annexation-of-crimea, claim TL:RUS:event:2014:annexation-of-crimea, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Full-scale invasion of Ukraine
claims.summary: Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, the largest war in Europe since 1945, prompting sweeping Western sanctions, international isolation, and an International Criminal Court arrest warrant for President Putin.

sources.label: Annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Russia: From the Viking princes of Kiev to a continental empire spanning eleven time zones.", terralore.co/country/RUS/chronicle#ev-2022-full-scale-invasion-of-ukraine, claim TL:RUS:event:2022:full-scale-invasion-of-ukraine, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
